theDEFECTREPAIRED.whyTHISISAREPAIRANDNOTASUBSTITUTION: a REJECTED instrument and an UNREVIEWED one are not the same standing, and the difference is not that one is better regarded. A rejected instrument carries a MEASURED statement that it does not do what the document says it does, so a green run from it is affirmatively misleading to a reader who has not read the review. An unreviewed instrument carries no statement either way, and a reader is on notice to disbelieve it -- which is the standing IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE.md section 7.8 says every companion instrument has anyway. The repair moves the pointer from a claim known false to a claim not yet made, and says so at every position rather than presenting the successor as evidence.
